name: locate-ranking dev set (tuned on)
rule: Written for the locate-ranking round before any ranking was run on it; labels read from the public tarballs at the refs below. The 14 cases tuned on. Each q is sent as is, with no repo or kind filter, over the whole index. Found at k (the round's criterion): a top-k pointer with the expected repo, one of the expected paths and one of the expected symbols. File level is reported beside it.
heldOutCompanion: dev-heldout.frozen.json (ids divisible by 3, never tuned on)
